prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, finish new_screen, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -6.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +7.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Flexibility Reassurance Hint: Add a hint box clarifying that chosen adoption styles can be modified or changed at any time later in settings. (why: The choose_path screen has high mean friction (514s), indicating user hesitation during choice.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Cloud Backup Sync Notification Hint: Show an active security notification hint on sign in confirming real-time desktop save state active status. (why: Addressing account sync concerns directly targets the single largest support category (8 emails regarding pet reset).)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Scroll Introductory Screen Reorder: Update story screen layout to story_scroll format before path choice to introduce the desktop companion story fluidly. (why: 23.8% of users abandon at choose_path; introducing story scroll builds early engagement before path selection.)

scores.note: Choose_path has high mean time friction (514s); adding a flexibility hint is low cost but lacks support email evidence.
Strong alignment with top support complaints (8 emails) and previous sign_in notification test showed +7.6% lift.
